# Citing this Guide {#sec-98-citing-this-guide .unnumbered}

<!-- page-provenance:start -->
::: {.page-provenance}
*R. Heller · Date: 2026-05-11 · Last changed: 2026-11-09*
:::

The suggested citation is:

```{block, type='boxempty'}
**Heller, R.** (2026). *Methods in R: A Topic Reference for Biomedical Research and Peer Review* (Version 1.0.0). Self-published via GitHub Pages. <https://cttir.github.io/methods-in-r/>.
```

Download the reference as [BibTeX](citation-files/citation.bib) or [.ris](citation-files/citation.ris).
